mapper.insert: insert into credit_record ( user_id, change_type, change_score, current_score, reason, business_type, business_id, operator_id ) values ( #{userId}, #{changeType}, #{changeScore}, #{currentScore}, #{reason}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{operatorId} )
mapper.select: select id, change_type, change_score, current_score, reason, business_type, business_id, create_time from credit_record where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
select ifnull(sum(change_score), 0) from credit_record where user_id = #{userId} and change_type = 2
select count(1) from booking where user_id = #{userId} and breach_flag = 1
mapper.update: update sys_user set credit_score = #{creditScore}, update_time = now() where id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: insert into booking_breach_appeal ( booking_id, user_id, reason, appeal_status, deduct_score, audit_remark, audit_user_id, audit_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{bookingId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{appealStatus}, #{deductScore}, #{auditRemark}, #{auditUserId}, #{auditTime}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.select: select id, booking_id, user_id, reason, appeal_status, deduct_score, audit_remark, audit_user_id, audit_time, is_deleted, create_time, update_time from booking_breach_appeal where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1

select id, booking_id, user_id, reason, appeal_status, deduct_score, audit_remark, audit_user_id, audit_time, is_deleted, create_time, update_time from booking_breach_appeal where booking_id = #{bookingId} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update booking_breach_appeal set appeal_status = #{appealStatus}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and appeal_status = 0 and is_deleted = 0
